versions.changelog:
college-admission-planner v1.1.0 brings a comprehensive overhaul of the skill, focused on smarter, data-driven college application planning for Chinese Gaokao students.

- Adds full-process workflow: score positioning, target school/professional matching, multi-channel opportunity mining (including information gap options), and "冲稳保" (reach/match/safe) strategy generation.
- Introduces information gap exploit discovery (e.g., international cooperation programs, lower scores for out-of-province schools, special quotas).
- Automatically distinguishes between new and old Gaokao models; supports all provinces.
- Provides Markdown-format outputs with clear tables, stepwise plans, action checklists, and key date reminders.
- Explicitly clarifies scenario boundaries, data source hierarchies, and fallback procedures for missing data.
- Greatly improves guidance detail, output quality, and clarity for broader and practical Gaokao volunteer planning.
